concepts_actual_uses_and_mixup: Generic native Vec3 normalization is intrinsic mathematical arithmetic at a foreign library boundary. length_recip returns reciprocal Euclidean length; normalize multiplies self by that reciprocal and optionally asserts output finite. try_normalize admits only finite positive reciprocal, then multiplies the same self by the same scalar; returns Option instead of supplying a fallback. This does not make all finite inputs admissible (squared length may underflow/overflow).
